steps.cmd:
cat > /app/output/gen.py <<'PY'
"""Original camera-guided controller, using only rcb_client observations.
Interactive commands and every executed action are recorded under output/.
"""
import os, json, time, numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from rcb_client import Robot
from PIL import Image
r=Robot()
spec=r.spec()
cams=list(spec['cameras'])
seq=0
obs=r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none')

def state():
    return np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'])

def save(label='obs'):
    global seq
    seq+=1
    path=f'/app/output/{seq:03d}_{label}'
    obs.save(path)
    for cam,im in obs.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save('/app/output/'+cam+'.png')
    open('/app/output/latest.json','w').write(json.dumps(obs.meta,indent=2))
    print('saved',path,'eef',state()[26:29], 'q',state()[4:11], 'fingers',state()[11:13], 'time',obs.meta['time_left_s'],flush=True)

def observe():
    global obs
    obs=r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none');save()

def act(q=None,grip=None,n=30,base=None,torso=0,label='move'):
    global obs
    s=state(); start=s[4:11]; q=start if q is None else np.array(q)
    A=np.zeros((n,13));t=np.linspace(0,1,n);t=t*t*(3-2*t)
    A[:,:7]=start+(q-start)*t[:,None]
    A[:,7]=s[36] if grip is None else grip
    A[:,12]=-1
    if base is not None: A[:,8:11]=base; A[:,12]=1
    A[:,11]=torso
    np.save(f'/app/output/action_{seq+1:03d}.npy',A)
    obs=r.submit('joint_position',A,include_depth=True,video='none',note=label)
    save(label)

def point(cam,u,v):
    d=obs.depth[cam];d=d[-1] if d.ndim==3 else d
    c=obs.meta['cameras'][cam];K=np.array(c['intrinsic_cv']);T=np.array(c['cam2world_gl'])
    z=float(d[v,u]);p=np.linalg.inv(K)@np.array([u,v,1.])*z;p[1:]*=-1
    return T[:3,:3]@p+T[:3,3]

def fk(q):
    origins=[([0,0,.333],0),([0,0,0],-np.pi/2),([0,-.316,0],np.pi/2),([.0825,0,0],np.pi/2),([-.0825,.384,0],-np.pi/2),([0,0,0],np.pi/2),([.088,0,0],np.pi/2)]
    T=np.eye(4)
    for a,(p,rx) in zip(q,origins):
        M=np.eye(4);M[:3,:3]=Rot.from_euler('x',rx).as_matrix()@Rot.from_euler('z',a).as_matrix();M[:3,3]=p;T=T@M
    return T

def sample():
    s=state();return (s[4:11].copy(),s[26:29].copy(),np.array(obs.meta['cameras'][cams[3]]['cam2world_gl'])[:3,:3])
samples=[sample()]
save('start')
print('READY',flush=True)
while True:
    p='/app/output/command.py'
    if os.path.exists(p):
        code=open(p).read();os.unlink(p)
        with open('/app/output/executed.py','a') as f:f.write('\n'+code+'\n')
        try:exec(compile(code,p,'exec'),globals())
        except Exception:
            import traceback;traceback.print_exc()
        print('READY',flush=True)
    time.sleep(.1)
PY

# Fit rigid robot mounting and gripper geometry from proprioception and wrist camera.
def residual(x):
    B=Rot.from_rotvec(x[:3]).as_matrix();b=x[3:6];off=x[6:9];C=Rot.from_rotvec(x[9:12]).as_matrix()
    out=[]
    for q,p,R in samples:
        T=fk(q);out.extend((B@(T[:3,3]+T[:3,:3]@off)+b-p)*10)
        out.extend(Rot.from_matrix((B@T[:3,:3]@C).T@R).as_rotvec())
    return out
x=np.zeros(12);x[:3]=[0,0,np.pi/2];x[3:6]=[5.4,-.8,.8];x[6:9]=[0,0,.20]
fit=least_squares(residual,x,max_nfev=2000,xtol=1e-12,ftol=1e-12,gtol=1e-12)
print('FIT',fit.x,'rms',np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(fit.fun))))
B=Rot.from_rotvec(fit.x[:3]).as_matrix();b=fit.x[3:6];off=fit.x[6:9];C=Rot.from_rotvec(fit.x[9:12]).as_matrix()
def pose(q):
    T=fk(q);return B@(T[:3,3]+T[:3,:3]@off)+b,B@T[:3,:3]@C
lo=np.array([-2.85,-1.74,-2.85,-3.04,-2.85,-.01,-2.85]);hi=np.array([2.85,1.74,2.85,-.08,2.85,3.73,2.85])
def ik(p,R,q0=None):
    q0=state()[4:11] if q0 is None else np.array(q0)
    def err(q):
        pp,RR=pose(q)
        return np.r_[(pp-p)*5,Rot.from_matrix(RR.T@R).as_rotvec(),.008*(q-q0)]
    sol=least_squares(err,q0,bounds=(lo,hi),max_nfev=300)
    print('IK residual',err(sol.x)[:6], 'q',sol.x)
    return sol.x
Rdown=np.eye(3) # camera +z up, viewing -z; image axes aligned with world
print('current prediction',pose(state()[4:11]),'actual',sample()[1:])
q=ik(np.array([5.413,-.494,1.13]),Rdown)
act(q,n=70,label='above_shrimp')

# Cartesian interpolation keeps the hand orientation fixed through the motion.
def cart(p,R,grip=1,n=80,label='cartesian'):
    global obs
    s=state();q=s[4:11].copy();p0,R0=pose(q)
    rot_delta=Rot.from_matrix(R0.T@R).as_rotvec()
    A=[]
    for t in np.linspace(0,1,n):
        t=t*t*(3-2*t);pt=p0+(np.array(p)-p0)*t;Rt=R0@Rot.from_rotvec(rot_delta*t).as_matrix()
        def err(qq):
            pp,RR=pose(qq)
            return np.r_[(pp-pt)*5,Rot.from_matrix(RR.T@Rt).as_rotvec(),.002*(qq-q)]
        sol=least_squares(err,np.clip(q,lo+1e-7,hi-1e-7),bounds=(lo,hi),max_nfev=100)
        q=sol.x
        if np.linalg.norm(pose(q)[0]-pt)>.015: raise ValueError('Unreachable Cartesian path')
        A.append(np.r_[q,grip,0,0,0,0,-1])
    A=np.array(A);np.save(f'/app/output/action_{seq+1:03d}.npy',A)
    obs=r.submit('joint_position',A,include_depth=True,video='none',note=label);save(label)
